text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute wasn't feeling well, so I 
brought her to the infirmary...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I'll get all rested up and come 
right back, okay?
(Whooooosh――......)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, where is this...?

"Once upon a time, in a certain place, a 
great big leaf grew."

"Until now, no matter how hard the wind 
blew, the leaves didn't budge at all."
""However, as Wonder Acute draws near—""
(Pooooooop!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Howaah!?

" 'Leaves swirled gently in midair, and a 
gigantic, enormous radish popped right out 
of the ground!' "

text_block_list.name: Radish Man
text_block_list.text: Hello!! My name is Daikonman!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Holy moly! Now that is one massive daikon 
radish~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"And so, Daikon-man... was it? What might 
you be doing in a place like this?"

text_block_list.name: Radish Man
text_block_list.text:
I came to say thank you to you today, 
Acute-san! Thank you for always eating my 
food with such relish!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oho~ I don't quite get it, but it's always 
nice to be thanked.

"Daikon Man smiles warmly. Yet his pure 
white face looks just a little bit 
lonely."

text_block_list.name: Radish Man
text_block_list.text:
And also, I have a favor to ask. Would you 
please hear me out?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hm, what is it? Go ahead and say it.

text_block_list.name: Radish Man
text_block_list.text:
"There's just... one thing troubling me. 
People only ever think of daikon in stews 
or pickles."

text_block_list.name: Radish Man
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I think my potential isn't limited 
to just that!"

text_block_list.name: Radish Man
text_block_list.text:
"So please, lend me your help! Help me 
create new daikon dishes and carve out my 
future together!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see. If that's the case, leave it 
to me. After all, it's my beloved daikon. 
I have to repay the favor.

text_block_list.name: Radish Man
text_block_list.text:
Really!? Thank you, Acute-san! Well then, 
until we meet again... someday—

"‘And so, the giant white radish flew into 
the sky and vanished into the blue 
beyond—’"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
A new daikon dish, huh... Well now, what 
on earth would be good...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: —*gasp*

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I got it! A sweet treat that brings 
out the sweetness and crisp texture of 
daikon radish!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Its name is... Daikon Radish Shaved Ice!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's get right down to making 
it, shall weee?!

Perhaps feeling refreshed and uplifted, 
Wonder Acute seemed to have regained her 
top form.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...Mmm.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
No good... All I can come up with are 
simmered dishes or crunchy snacks.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Sorry I couldn't be of help... Daikon-man.

Unable to clear her mind, Wonder Acute's 
condition failed to improve...
